Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX.4.2. Must be the first field in message.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Must be second field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Must be the third field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Message sequence number.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: SenderCompID as assigned by NASDAQ. The maximum size is 4 to 6 characters.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: TargetCompID as assigned by NASDAQ. The maximum size is 4 to 6 characters.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Required by FIX but not validated by NASDAQ.

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Ignored. When sending execution report NASDAQ will send INET in this field.

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Ignored. When sending execution report NASDAQ will provide SenderSubID in this field.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Should be present on retransmitted messages, whether prompted by the sending system or as the result of a resend request.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Required when message may be duplicate of another message sent under a different sequence number.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Required for message resends but not validated by NASDAQ.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Modulo 256 checksum of all characters in message up to and including the delimiter preceding the CheckSum field. Three digits with leading zeroes if necessary.

Message.Name: Heartbeat
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message. Sent when the agreed HeartbeatInterval has elapsed since the last message sent, and in reply to a Test Request.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Required when the heartbeat is the result of a Test Request message. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Identifier included in the Test Request message to be returned in the resulting Heartbeat. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: ResendRequest
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message. Open (EndSeqNo 0) and closed sequence ranges are honored.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of first message in range to be resent. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of last message in range to be resent; 0 for infinity. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: Reject
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message. Session level rejects indicate violations of the session protocol or missing (or invalid) fields.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum of rejected message. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: RefTagID
Field.Description: The tag number of the FIX field being referenced. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: The MsgType of the FIX message being referenced. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: SessionRejectReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for a session-level Reject message. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Where possible, message to explain reason for rejection. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: SequenceReset
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message. Gap Fill (GapFillFlag = Y) messages follow standard sequencing; Reset (GapFillFlag not Y) is used only as a last resort, by human intervention.

Field.Name: GapFillFlag
Field.Description: Indicates that the Sequence Reset message is replacing administrative or application messages which will not be resent. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: New sequence number. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: Logout
Message.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 session message. Either side may issue a Logout to gracefully close the session.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free format text. FIX 4.2 standard field.

Message.Name: Logon
Message.Description: The Logon must be the first message sent by the subscriber after the TCP connection is established. The IP Address of the subscriber, the SenderCompId and TargetCompId will be validated; if validation fails, the connection will be dropped. After an unexpected disconnect, a Logon Acknowledgement with a sequence number greater than expected means in-flight messages were missed and should be recovered with a Resend Request.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: FIX 4.2 standard required field. Ignored: FIX level encryption is not supported.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: HeartbeatInterval must be specified by the subscriber in whole seconds; the accepted value is returned on the Logon Acknowledgement. A value as low as possible is recommended so disconnects are detected sooner.

Message.Name: ExecutionReport
Message.Description: Outbound sequenced drop copy of order and trade activity, configurable to trade, order or both types of messages. Confirms the receipt of an order, changes to and cancelation of an existing order, relays fill information on working orders and reports trade busts or other post-trade corrections. Regular orders are reported atomically, multi-leg orders per leg, regular crossing orders per side and multi-leg crossing orders per leg per side, in any order. Manual trades omit order related tags (ClOrdID, QuoteID, Price, OrdType, TimeInForce) and OrdStatus, report ExecType 2 and ExecTransType 0 with OrderQty, LeavesQty, CumQty and AvgPx 0. Trade cancellations report ExecTransType 1 with ExecRefID; successful post trade allocations or corrections report a trade cancel followed by a new trade, both with ExecRefID.

Field.Name: AvgPx
Field.Description: Will be 0 for busts or other post-trade corrections

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique order identifier per incoming protocol connection (may not be unique for the drop session)

Field.Name: QuoteID
Field.Description: Identifier of the SQF quote/sweep being reported. If TIF = 3 (IOC) and this tag is present, it refers to a sweep-id sent by the client. If TIF = 0 (DAY) and this tag is present, it refers to a quote-id sent by the client. 8-byte binary SQF Ids are encoded as 16-byte ASCII strings where each byte is represented by two 0-F ASCII characters, e.g. 5E for 0x5e.

Field.Name: CumQty
Field.Description: Will be 0 for busts or other post-trade corrections

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Internal trade ID

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: G = All Or None (AON), f = Intermarket Sweep Order (ISO). Fill or Kill orders are represented with ExecInst G and TimeInForce IOC.

Field.Name: ExecRefID
Field.Description: Populated with the reference ExecID on trade cancellations and on the cancel and new trade messages of post trade allocations and corrections.

Field.Name: ExecTransType
Field.Description: 0 = New, 1 = Cancel. Trade breaks will be sent with an ExecTransType of 1. NASDAQ does not support trade corrections.

Field.Name: LastMkt
Field.Description: For stock trades, market that executed the stock leg: space = Nasdaq Execution Services. For option linkage trades, away execution exchange. All values NON-STANDARD.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Unique ID assigned by exchange. Populated on busts and other post trade corrections.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Will be 0 for manual trades.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Conditional: necessary for electronic trades and absent for manual trades. 0 = New, 1 = Partially Filled, 2 = Filled, 4 = Canceled, 5 = Replaced. 2 (Filled) on trade cancellations and post trade allocations when the original trade is not a manual trade.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Named OrdTyp in the document. Not present on manual trades.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Not present on manual trades.

Field.Name: Rule80A
Field.Description: Named StockCapacity (Rule80A) in the document: capacity of the stock leg.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Security symbol for option executions or will populate with underlying on stock leg executions

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free format text string. In case of orders, replaces and fills, will be an optional 13 character supplementary id if specified on order entry. In case of cancel will also contain NASDAQ cancel reason code (#SUP = Supervisory: the order was manually cancelled or reduced by a NASDAQ supervisory terminal).

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Not present on manual trades.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of execution. YYYYMMDD-HH-mm:SS (seconds), YYYYMMDD-HH-mm:SS.sss (milliseconds) or YYYYMMDD-HH-mm:SS.sss.sssssssss (nanoseconds); firm can choose level of confirmation at the port level

Field.Name: ExecBroker
Field.Description: Order updates will provide only if provided on original inbound order. Execution updates will always provide give-up from execution

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: Not present for a stock leg.

Field.Name: StopPx
Field.Description: Populated on busts and other post trade corrections.

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Populated on busts and other post trade corrections.

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: 0 = New, 1 = Partially Filled, 2 = Filled, 4 = Canceled, 5 = Replace. 2 (Filled) for manual trades, trade cancellations and post trade allocations or corrections.

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Number of contracts open for further execution. If the OrdStatus is Cancelled, DoneForTheDay, Expired, Calculated, or Rejected (in which case the order is no longer active) then LeavesQty could be 0, otherwise LeavesQty = OrderQty - CumQty. 0 on busts and other post trade corrections.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: CS, OPT or MLEG (configurable by request). Multi-leg orders are reported per leg: MLEG (default) for all legs, or CS and OPT depending on the leg instrument type.

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: Named CallOrPut in the document. 0 = Put, 1 = Call. Not present for a stock leg.

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Not present for a stock leg.

Field.Name: CustomerOrFirm
Field.Description: 0 = Customer, 1 = Firm, 5 = Nasdaq registered Market Maker, 2 = Broker Dealer, 8 = Professional Customer, 4 = Other exchange registered Market Maker, 7 = Joint Back Office (PHLX, NOM and BX only). Can be configured to provide OCC Capacity.

Field.Name: MaturityDate
Field.Description: Month, Day and Year of the maturity. Format YYYYMMDD (e.g. 20100918 to represent Sept 18, 2010). Not present for a stock leg.

Field.Name: DayOrderQty
Field.Description: GTC/GTD orders only: DayOrderQty is the OrderQty minus the contracts that were traded on previous days.

Field.Name: DayCumQty
Field.Description: GTC/GTD orders only: the number of contracts that have traded today. Will be 0 for busts or other post-trade corrections

Field.Name: DayAvgPx
Field.Description: GTC/GTD orders only: the average price of contracts that have traded today. Will be 0 for busts or other post-trade corrections

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: CMTA

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: OCC sub-account

Field.Name: MultiLegReportingType
Field.Description: 2 = Individual leg of a multi-leg security, 3 = Multi-leg security

Field.Name: SeriesID
Field.Description: InstrumentID. Listed twice in the document table. Not present for a stock leg.

Field.Name: StockLegGiveUp
Field.Description: Stock Leg Give Up

Field.Name: AuctionType
Field.Description: P = PIM, F = Facilitation, S = Solicitation, B = Block, C = Customer to Customer Cross, Q = QCC, X = Flex Auction

Field.Name: UnderlyingPx
Field.Description: Named UnderlyingQty in the document (FIX 4.2 tag 810 is UnderlyingPx). Present only in QCC Order ER (if user provided at order entry).

Field.Name: UnderlyingQty
Field.Description: Named UnderlyingPrice in the document (FIX tag 879 is UnderlyingQty). Present only in QCC Order ER (if user provided at order entry).

Field.Name: RoutingStrategy
Field.Description: DNR, SRCH, FIND or POST

Field.Name: DisplayWhen
Field.Description: 1 = Immediate, 2 = Exhaust. As specified for the reserve order.

Field.Name: PriceProtectionScope
Field.Description: Populated on busts and other post trade corrections.

Field.Name: StepUpPriceType
Field.Description: Named Stepup Price Type in the document. 1 = Market, 2 = Limit

Field.Name: StepUpPrice
Field.Description: Named Stepup Price in the document.

Field.Name: CounterpartyExecBrokerClearingFirm
Field.Description: Trade counter-party CMTA. NON-STANDARD field - DROP COPY ONLY

Field.Name: CounterpartyExecBroker
Field.Description: Trade counterparty OCC Number. NON-STANDARD field - DROP COPY ONLY

Field.Name: CounterpartyCustomerOrFirm
Field.Description: Trade counter-party client category: 0 = Customer, 1 = Firm, 5 = Nasdaq registered Market Maker, 2 = Broker Dealer, 8 = Professional Customer, 4 = Other exchange registered Market Maker, 7 = Joint Back Office (not supported at this time)

Field.Name: FloorBrokerNumber
Field.Description: The Floor Broker Number in case of a Floor Order or Trade

Field.Name: OrderSource
Field.Description: B = Floor/FBMS. This tag will only be present in case of Floor orders/Trades.

Field.Name: LiquidityIndicator
Field.Description: Liquidity code of the execution

Field.Name: PriceDelta
Field.Description: Present only in QCC Order ER (if user provided at order entry)
